data.title: Data quality (audit + gates)
data.summary: Per-shot ShotQualityReport, corpus audit, ambix data audit CLI, acceptance gates for training-grade shots.

sections.body: Twenty-two pytest tests on a 25-shot sample give 76% usable rate. Failures: charge_exchange ~50% bit-pattern corruption; thomson_scattering ~12% timestamp drift; magnetics ~3% NaN sections. Tracked per-shot in imas_ambix.quality.ShotQualityReport.

A shot is training-grade if (a) magnetics complete, (b) ≥1 camera channel complete, (c) equilibrium time-slice present, (d) no NaN in summary scalars. Drop charge_exchange entirely from the v0 corpus (decision 2026-05-20).

drop-charge-exchange.rationale: 12–28 orders of magnitude beyond physical range; filter would mask the underlying ingestion bug. Re-include in v1 after upstream fix.

notes.body: Re-deriving training-grade-shots.json without CX shrinks the corpus by ~8% — acceptable.

questions.body: Should we re-include charge_exchange in v1 once FAIR-MAST fixes the encoding, or treat it as a learned upstream untrustable?

followups.title: Re-derive training-grade-shots.json excluding CX
followups.body: drop-charge-exchange decision is locked. Regenerate the training-grade manifest from the full 11,573-shot L2 audit, update §5 with the new shot count, and confirm world-model-v0 read path picks up the new file. Code path: extend imas_ambix/data/manifest.py (the existing manifest module) — there is no imas_ambix/quality/manifest.py.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix
Plan: data-quality (§5 training-grade gate)
Tier: sonnet

Context
  Decision drop-charge-exchange is locked → drop entirely. We need a deterministic training_grade.py that loads the corpus audit, filters by the §5 criteria (magnetics complete, ≥1 camera channel, equilibrium time-slice, no scalar NaNs, no charge_exchange), and writes training-grade-shots.json to the repo root.

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/data-quality.json
  imas_ambix/data/manifest.py    (existing manifest module — extend, do NOT create imas_ambix/quality/manifest.py)
  imas_ambix/quality/audit.py    (ShotQualityReport schema)

Locked decisions to honour
  drop-charge-exchange → yes — drop entirely from v0 corpus

Open decisions to surface (do not resolve)
  data-quality q1 (re-include CX in v1?)

Constraints
  - The full L2 mirror lives at /work/projects/imas_gpu/mast/level2/
  - Audit can be run with: uv run ambix data audit --from-bucket-all --tier level2 --workers 16 --output /tmp/audit-full.json
  - This is CPU-only; do NOT submit to SLURM. Run on a login node or background it with `run_in_background`.
  - Workers=16 is safe; the login node has 64 cores and we are exclusive on the GPU node so no contention.

Done-when
  1. New file imas_ambix/data/training_grade.py with a TrainingGradeFilter class + CLI hook (`ambix data training-grade --audit-path ...` ideally, or a small module-run path)
  2. training-grade-shots.json at repo root with the filtered shot id list + counts by exclusion reason
  3. Plan state updated: docs/state/imas-ambix/data-quality.json `data.impl` → 1.0, `data.status` → shipped
  4. This followup resolved with the new shot count + new followup for world-model-v0 confirming read-path
  5. Tests added in tests/ for the filter logic (no integration test required for the corpus run)
